inputs.name: reviewHash.value
inputs.description: Text whose UTF-8 bytes are hashed with SHA-256. An empty string is valid input and produces the digest of empty input.

inputs.name: readReviewInput.root
inputs.description: Filesystem path used as the project root when locating and checking a review file. It is resolved with realpath before the file is checked for containment.

inputs.name: readReviewInput.path
inputs.description: Path joined to the project root to locate a review file and returned unchanged in its record. The resolved target must be inside the root, a regular non-symlink file, and no larger than 1 MiB.

inputs.name: reviewInputsCurrent.root
inputs.description: Filesystem path used as the project root when resolving and checking each review input. A path or file read failure makes the result false.

inputs.name: reviewInputsCurrent.inputs
inputs.description: Review input records whose paths are re-read under root and whose hashes are compared with the supplied hashes. Any mismatch or read failure returns false, while an empty list returns true.

outputs.name: reviewHash
outputs.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the input string. The digest contains 64 hexadecimal characters.

outputs.name: readReviewInput
outputs.description: A record containing the requested path, file contents decoded as UTF-8, and the lowercase SHA-256 hash of those contents. It is returned only for a resolved regular file inside the project root that is not a symlink and is at most 1 MiB.

outputs.name: reviewInputsCurrent
outputs.description: Indicates whether every supplied input can be re-read and has the same hash as before. Returns false on a mismatch or read failure and true for an empty input list.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Raised when readReviewInput finds a path outside the project root, a symlink or non-file, or a file larger than 1 MiB; filesystem resolution, inspection, and read failures also reject with an error. reviewInputsCurrent catches these read failures and returns false.
